handoff: Approve: all five criteria are proven in upgrade-wording.test.ts: rewrite and stage, one refused file is non-fatal, a rerun is a no-op, an all-new repo is untouched, run state is unchanged. 23 upgrade integration tests pass. Two non-blocking notes (commit-hint wording, symlinked files).

findings.title: Workflow-only upgrade suggests the 'Refresh norn's skills' commit
findings.detail:
When norn_version is unchanged (repo already at the running version) but workflow files were rewritten, stage is non-empty so commit = SKILLS_COMMIT ('Refresh norn's skills (norn upgrade)'), which misnames a change that may touch only .agents/workflows/. Harmless (the person can edit the message) and the handoff says the wording was kept on purpose.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optionally pick a message that covers workflows too when workflows.rewritten is non-empty.

findings.title: A symlinked workflow file is replaced by a regular file
findings.detail:
readFileSync follows a symlink in .agents/workflows/, and atomicWrite renames a temp file over the link, so the link becomes a copy. Unusual layout; no criterion covers it.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Leave as is, or skip/refuse symlinks.
